message: Hey Jane, hope you are doing well! How is your workplace these days? I personally found workplace illness is a serious problem.
Morning Jane, just wanted to let you know that Mark and Lisa are out with the flu. We'll need to adjust the schedule accordingly.
Can you believe Tommy is turning 5 next week? We should start planning his birthday party!
Hi Jane, your order of art supplies has been dispatched and should arrive by Monday. Thank you for choosing Creative Kids Art Supply Co.
I've received the art supplies invoice from Creative Kids. Should I file it under this month's expenses?
Dinner last night was so much fun! We should do it again soon. Maybe when the flu season is over? 😅
Reminder: Staff meeting tomorrow at 10 AM. We'll discuss the new hygiene protocols to prevent the spread of flu.
Jane, the parents appreciated the notice about the flu cases. Thanks for handling the communication so well.
I'm worried about the flu spreading at my office. I hope Tom and David will recover soon. They two were in the office yesterday...
Hey, I've scheduled a deep clean for the center this weekend to ensure we're taking all precautions against the flu.
